description: feature:officer — implement 4 officer screens: BatchVerifyScreen (O-02), BatchAggregateScreen (O-03), BatchDetailScreen (O-04), CoopLedgerScreen (O-05) with OfficerViewModel + BatchViewModel + LedgerViewModel (@HiltViewModel + StateFlow), and wire officer navigation into NangaNavHost (4 officer tabs Home/Verify/Batches/Profile; routes officer/verify, officer/aggregate, officer/batch/{batchId}, officer/ledger; remove old officer/batch). The batch flow verify -> aggregate -> detail (mark aggregated/sold) and ledger -> detail must navigate correctly. INDEPENDENT of other FEATs but is the largest; depends on no other FEAT output.

Create feature/officer/src/main/java/com/nanga/feature/officer/BatchViewModel.kt: @HiltViewModel class BatchViewModel : ViewModel() exposing StateFlow<BatchUiState> seeded with 7 verified catches (Ali Tuna 12.5kg Malindi Bay VERIFIED; Fatma Shark 8kg Kilifi VERIFIED; Omar Octopus 3.2kg Watamu VERIFIED; + 4 more) all selected by default. Also expose detail ops for BatchDetailScreen: markCatchAggregated(batchId,id), markCatchSold(batchId,id), markAllAggregated(batchId), markAllSold(batchId) updating each catch's state, and a detail batch (name, stats, catches) loaded from the same sample. For detail, add loadBatch(batchId) populating a detail state field.

acceptance_criteria: BatchVerifyScreen (O-02) renders a checklist with GPS/photo status, flagged catches in red, an Officer DID attestation card, an Approve button, and a Reject flagged catch ghost button
BatchAggregateScreen (O-03) renders a batch name input, verified-catch checkboxes, a running totals card, and a Create batch button

BatchDetailScreen (O-04) renders a teal gradient batch header with 3 stats and per-catch Mark aggregated (teal) -> Mark sold (bronze) -> Done status progression, plus Mark all aggregated / Mark all sold bulk actions
CoopLedgerScreen (O-05) renders a 3-tab toggle, a 4-metric summary card, a batch list with status badges, top fishers with tier badges, and Export CSV
Navigation works end to end: officer Verify -> Aggregate (on approve) -> Detail (on create) and Ledger -> Detail (batch row tap)
OfficerViewModel, BatchViewModel, LedgerViewModel are @HiltViewModel exposing StateFlow
OfficerScreen.kt stub is removed and NangaNavHost officerTabs shows 4 tabs (Home/Verify/Batches/Profile); old officer/batch route removed
No hardcoded Color(0x..) hex in feature/officer; only NangaTheme tokens + MaterialTheme.colorScheme
